run_unet_forward_pass: run the UNet2DConditionModel forward pass with a noisy sample, timestep, and encoder hidden states
enable_freeu_mechanism: enable the FreeU mechanism on UNet2DConditionModel upsample blocks with scaling factors s1, s2, b1, b2
fuse_qkv_projections: fuse QKV projections in UNet2DConditionModel attention modules for faster self-attention and cross-attention inference
set_attention_slice: enable sliced attention computation on UNet2DConditionModel to reduce memory usage at the cost of speed
set_default_attn_processor: reset UNet2DConditionModel attention processors to the default AttnProcessor or AttnAddedKVProcessor implementation
